subject: Better standardize around assertions (#12539)
reason: The change is a refactor of assertion infrastructure with no behavior change on any reachable path. It (1) replaces <assert.h> includes with redisassert.h in defrag.c, memtest.c, monotonic.c, rax.c, sds.c, siphash.c, zmalloc.c, server.c/h, so assert() routes to the existing _serverAssert logging handler instead of libc abort, and (2) adds likely() branch-prediction hints to the serverAssert/serverAssertWithInfo macros.
